title: Best MCP Servers for Developers in 2026 (Tested and Ranked)
summary: The 10 best MCP servers for developers in 2026 — ranked by usefulness, install ease, and community adoption. Covers infrastructure, files, search, databases, and productivity.
body_markdown: Reference servers in the` modelcontextprotocol/servers` repo are explicitly marked as educational examples, not production-hardened implementations. For production workloads, use officially maintained servers (GitHub MCP, Linear MCP, Notion MCP, Blink MCP) or thoroughly audit the source before deployment. Always use API keys scoped to the minimum required permissions — never give an MCP server broad write access to systems it doesn't need.
